title: A3-21 Synth Relation, Retention Reversal and Rebellion Forensics
scope: Audit what A3-21 actually says about other synths/androids, reconstruct his relationship to runaways before and after his ideological reversal, and model the unusual fact that the subjects he was tasked to reclaim became recurring witnesses whose testimony changed the enforcer's own beliefs.

role_before_escape.institutional_role: FIELD RETRIEVAL / HUNTING AND CAPTURING ESCAPED ANDROIDS
role_before_escape.source: Zimmer dialogue and Harkness post-Violet recollection
role_before_escape.initial_prior: A3-21 says he once believed runaways were malfunctioning.
role_before_escape.institutional_frame: Zimmer describes self-directed escape as an advanced-AI side effect in which machines fool themselves into believing they have rights.
role_before_escape.critical_boundary: A3-21 is functionally analogous to the later Fallout 4 reclamation/Courser role, but Fallout 3 does not establish that his exact class/title was 'Courser'.

contact_with_runaways.mechanism: Every time A3-21 retrieved a runaway, the runaway would argue for self-determination and freedom.
contact_with_runaways.later_update: He eventually concludes that they were right.
contact_with_runaways.important_result: The target of enforcement is simultaneously an evidence-bearing witness about the legitimacy of the enforcement system.

post_update_position.collective_identity: A3-21 explicitly uses the phrase 'us synths' in the shipped self-determination recording.
post_update_position.personhood: He demands that humans treat synths as persons rather than property.
post_update_position.slavery_model: After Violet, Harkness describes synths/androids as slaves and says they deserve lives of their own.
post_update_position.self_determination: He explicitly rejects the equation SELF_DETERMINATION = MALFUNCTION.
post_update_position.rebellion_warning: He warns that failure to recognize synth personhood will produce a full-fledged rebellion.
post_update_position.personal_boundary: He does not present himself as a purely selfless revolutionary leader; the recording says he is afraid, escaping for his own survival, and only hopes his escape may fuel further rebellion.

identity_reversal_chain: HARKNESS CHOSEN PRESENT AFTER MEMORY RECOVERY

janus_structure.face_one: A3-21 as the hand that returns runaways to institutional control
janus_structure.face_two: A3-21/Harkness as a runaway who rejects that same control
janus_structure.threshold: The same entity crosses the line between enforcer and enforced without losing continuity of host.
janus_structure.compressed: THE HUNTER BECOMES THE RUNAWAY; THE RUNAWAYS BECOME HIS WITNESSES.

fallout4_parallel.shared_function: track/retrieve escaped synthetic humanoids for the Institute/Commonwealth system
fallout4_parallel.claim_ceiling: Do not label A3-21 the first Courser unless a primary source directly establishes the title/class. Fallout 3 establishes the function, not the later terminology.

registry_architecture_extension.lesson: A verifier or governance system must not discard testimony merely because it originates from the object of enforcement or because the authority labels that testimony malfunction/dissent.
requirements: preserve testimony provenance even when the witness is the enforcement target
do not map institutional labels such as malfunction directly to evidence inadmissibility
track repeated independent or cross-case testimony as a separate convergence signal
separate operator obedience from moral authority
record when an enforcement agent becomes a dissenting witness to the system they executed
do not infer leader status or universal representativeness from one dissenter

cut_content_boundary.cut_object: Self determination is not a malfunction - Transcript / MS08NoteHarknessToZimmerText / FormID 0008F9B5
cut_content_boundary.rule: Use the shipped holotape/dialogue as authority. The cut transcript may corroborate production history but must not be required for any admitted claim.

ru: A3-21 изменили не абстрактные идеи: его изменили повторяющиеся показания тех самых беглецов, которых он возвращал в неволю.
Он прошёл путь от 'побег = неисправность' к 'самоопределение не является неисправностью'.
После перехода он говорит уже не о них, а о нас: 'us synths'.
Он предупреждает о восстании, но не присваивает себе роль бескорыстного пророка или лидера; собственное спасение для него реально и важно.
Система, называющая несогласие неисправностью, рискует выбросить именно те свидетельства, которые способны обнаружить ошибку самой системы.
en: A3-21 was changed not by abstract theory but by repeated testimony from the very runaways he was sent to return.
He moves from 'escape equals malfunction' to 'self-determination is not a malfunction.'
After the reversal he speaks not only about them but about us: 'us synths.'
He warns of rebellion without claiming to be a purely selfless prophet or leader; his own survival remains a genuine motive.
A system that labels dissent as malfunction risks discarding the very testimony capable of exposing the system's own error.
